images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE 1, the 1536x1024 terrain canvas, and return exactly ONE 1536x1024 PNG. IMAGE 2 is solely the approved painting style reference, never a composition reference.
Outpaint ONLY the flat tan and grey guide areas of IMAGE 1. Its TOP 256 rows and LEFT 256 columns, including their corner, are already finished neighbouring terrain pixels: preserve those pixels exactly, with every stone, grass blade, shadow and texture unchanged. Continue those finished strips seamlessly into all unpainted guide areas, eliminating the horizontal join at y=256 and vertical join at x=256.
Keep the canvas geometry and every guide boundary exactly in place. Preserve EVERY existing pure green #00ff00 pixel exactly; green is empty void with a hard unchanged silhouette, no painting, texture, spill, shadows or antialias expansion into it. TAN means packed dirt cliff-top path: replace with continuous warm ochre dirt, small stones, cracks and restrained directional wear that match the already painted strips. LIGHT GREY means grassy rocky verge: replace with rocks and grass of precisely the same scale, colours, lighting and density as the verge in the painted strips. This includes the long curved grey band along the left green boundary and the small grey areas at the extreme right edge. If dark grey/brown vertical cliff guide planes are present, paint continuous rock down toward the viewer until green, slightly darker and hazier below with no bottom ledge. If dark boulder blocks or brown bridge planks or magenta loose planks are present, paint those shapes as indicated; do not invent any absent feature.
Orthographic elevated three-quarter view around 45 degrees, no perspective shrinking toward the top. Warm SUNSET key from screen UPPER-LEFT, cool violet shadows. HAND-DRAWN painted 2D with confident tapered dark contours of varying weight, clean painted material planes, restrained texture, readable silhouettes, bold jewel tones and graphic shadows, matching IMAGE 2 and the existing finished strips precisely. Environmental richness, no conspicuous grain. Preserve the existing feature scale. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette. Do not import IMAGE 2's cliff layout. Preserve IMAGE 1's layout and green silhouette literally. Fill every flat guide region and keep the finished strips unchanged.

references.role: edit target: painted strips and geometry guide

concerns: Confirmed 1536×1024 output. Visual inspection shows completed terrain without obvious strip joins; exact pixel preservation of painted strips, guide boundaries and #00ff00 remains unverified.
